literalQuestion.content: 주축의 길이가 6이고 꼭짓점의 좌표가 (0,0), (0,p)인 쌍곡선의 두 점근선이 서로 수직이다. 이 쌍곡선이 점 (k,9)를 지날 때, 양수 k의 값은?
literalQuestion.pixelReview: All literal terms, symbols, and signs are readable in the 300dpi crop. The printed condition is 양수 k; every printed choice is negative. No printed p>0/p=6 qualifier or other sign restriction appears. Handwritten pencil marks are annotations, not printed conditions.

singleLocusAssessment.reason: With principal-axis length 6 and vertices (0,0),(0,p), the source fixes only |p|=6. Perpendicular asymptotes give equal semi-axes. For p=6, the negative k candidate is −3√3; for p=−6 it is −3√15, which is absent. The sign edit alone cannot establish one answer; setting p=6 would be a second unsupported source change.

requiredRemainingInput: Authoritative correction/answer-key evidence that resolves both the sign restriction on k and the intended signed vertex coordinate p, or a source-owner corrected page.
